conventions.model: R-parity-conserving MSSM, released lowMSSM real soft/trilinear input parameters; not CMSSM or NMSSM
conventions.input_scheme: DRbar real parameters at source-defined iterated SUSY boundary; TanBeta imposed at MZ low-scale boundary
conventions.susy_scale: sqrt(product_i(MSu_i ** (abs(ZU_i3)**2+abs(ZU_i6)**2))) from released constraint; no arbitrary Qin input
conventions.gauge: GAUGE1 written as non-GUT-normalized gY; no implicit basis conversion
conventions.majorana: signed masses retained; force-positive option disabled; imaginary output mixings retained
conventions.decays: No generated FlexibleDecay implementation in this released model; missing widths/channels remain unknown
conventions.input_matrices: TEIN/TDIN/TUIN trilinears have GeV, five MS*2IN matrices GeV^2; no automatic A-to-T conversion
conventions.scope: source construction and complete transport only; numerical/decay/lifetime/model validity not certified
